trap.label: certeza excessiva
trap.wrong: The data prove that coffee causes insomnia.
trap.right: The data suggest that coffee may be linked to insomnia.
trap.why: Em português afirmamos “os dados provam”. Em análise acadêmica, em inglês, evita-se certeza: use suggest, may, associate.

mcq.why: suggest = cautela; prove é forte demais.

mcq.q: “Had the sample been larger, the result ___ clearer.”
Which is an **instruction** in a method?

fix.wrong: The model accounts 40% of the variation.
fix.right: The model accounts for 40% of the variation.

fix.wrong: Would the sample been larger, we would trust it.
fix.right: Had the sample been larger, we would trust it.

fix.wrong: We must delete the duplicate record, then to check it.
fix.right: We must delete the duplicate record, then check it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com inversão: “If the sample had been larger, we would have found more.”
rewrite.answer: Had the sample been larger, we would have found more.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com cautela (may be associated): “Smoking causes this.”
rewrite.answer: Smoking may be associated with this.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com account for: “Age explains most of the gap.”
rewrite.answer: Age accounts for most of the gap.
